test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Disease that spreads by physical touch and contact
solution: The correct answer is '**Contagious**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Contagious**'. • It means '(used about a disease) that you can get by touching somebody/something'. [(रोग) संपर्क या स्‍पर्श द्वारा फैलने वाला; संसर्गज] • *Example: Measles is a highly **contagious** disease.* **Correct Answer:__** *Contagious.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Poisonous**: causing death or illness if you eat or drink it. [घातक (जिसे खाने या पीने से मृत्‍यु या कोई रोग हो जाए), विषाक्त] • **Contemptible**: not deserving any respect at all. (तिरस्‍करणीय; तिरस्‍कार के योग्‍य) • **Resistible**: capable of being resisted. (विरोध करने में सक्षम) 191:Tb23, The correct answer is '**Planned**'.
